test_cases.tc_title: The MDTDiagService shall interpret the received DID 0x283F request and extract the brightness level parameter. (write $283F, SID 2E, valid brightness)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. Security access 0x27 has been granted
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Read the current rearview camera brightness level
   $ 22 28 3F
2. Record the reported brightness level as Brightness_initial
3. Write a new brightness level within the supported range
   $ 2E 28 3F <brightness byte>
4. Read the rearview camera brightness level again
   $ 22 28 3F
test_cases.expected_result:
1. The positive response 62 28 3F <brightness byte> is received
2. Brightness_initial is recorded
3. The positive response 6E 28 3F is received
4. The positive response 62 28 3F <brightness byte> is received, and the reported brightness byte is the value
written in step 3
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

PC-2: SYSAD §4.5 Hardware Dependencies（Diagnostic connector (OBD-II)）
PC-3: SYSAD §4.5 Session & Security Assumptions（Security access (0x27) is required for: Write DID / Routine execution / DTC clearing）

test_cases.tc_title: The DiagService shall interpret the received 0x2F (InputOutputControlByIdentifier) request for DID 0x5000 and extract the tone output level / volume reference parameter. (I-O $5000, SID 2F, level tracks radio volume)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. Security access 0x27 has been granted
4. No specific tone output level is specified in the request
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Activate a buzzer control tone without specifying an output level
   $ 2F 50 00 <buzzer control tone selection>
2. Set the radio volume to a mid-range value and record the tone output level as Tone_initial
3. Increase the radio volume
4. Read the tone output level and record as Tone_after
test_cases.expected_result:
1. The positive response 6F 50 00 is received
2. Tone_initial is recorded
3. The radio volume is increased
4. Tone_after is greater than Tone_initial
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

test_cases.tc_title: The DiagService shall interpret the received 0x31 (RoutineControl) request for DID 0x0312 and extract the channel input selection parameter. (routine $0312, SID 31, startRoutine)
test_cases.pre_conditions:

2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. Security access 0x27 has been granted
4. An audio test tone of 1 kHz at 0 dB is applied to the channel input under test

   $ 31 01 03 12 <AV Channel Number>

   $ 31 03 03 12

2. The positive response 71 03 03 12 <routine results> is received, and the results indicate that a signal was
detected on the channel input under test

   $ 31 01 03 12 <AV Channel Number>

   $ 31 03 03 12

test_cases.tc_title: AMP shall process any chimes, and the HU shall switch phone call to cell phone.
test_cases.remarks: CFTS004 Category: Out of Scope; Harman Scope: Need Clarification

reasoning: 12 個 037 列產出 13 條 TC ＋ 1 佔列。拆分僅二處，皆依 R-DIAG1(b)：SWE1-Diagnostics-002 與 -113 之 negative 列各述「invalid length／incorrect format／unsupported DID」三種失效型態，拆為長度軸（NRC 13）與值域軸（NRC 31）二條；「incorrect format」與「invalid length」在 ISO 14229-1 同屬 0x13，不另拆。SWE1-Diagnostics-001 未拆 —— 037 Description 述「validate against the supported range」，而 CFTS004 $283F 三列（4939794／4939793／4939792）與其 Information 列皆未載該值域，依 R-DIAG8(c)（延伸只向 CFTS004 原文）與 IN §8.4.1（不造值）無從拆值域 sibling。SWE1-Diagnostics-272／-189 所掛之 CFTS004 條目各為單一子欄位（SXI Rev Major／RSErrs Terr Symbol），非整個 DID 之全部子欄位，故 ER 不作 §6.1 分項。SWE1-Diagnostics-154 之 037 Title 與 Description 互不相稱：Title 述 NRC 31，其內容對應 CFTS004-4940474/4940476（SYS-RA-DIAG-371，037 row 167，不在本 pilot 範圍）；Description 與本列所掛之 SYS-RA-DIAG-367（CFTS004-4940482）一致，述三訊號之偵測結果。依 IN §8.6（來源規格勝出）與 R-SEC15(f)（test_item 上半取 Description）產為正向結果回報，ER 依 §6.1 以 a./b./c. 分項。
